body: The wound is in home and family; the early foundation was unstable, and 'home' never felt safe.
business: You build for others the safe home you did not have.
shadow: Recreating the old instability, or never letting anyone near the core.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
